title: Candidate finite obstruction for degree 16
statement: Extending the published low-homology induction to degree 16 reduces the unresolved open input to W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{g,n}), expected Tate type Q(8), for (g,n)=(3,12),(5,8),(6,6),(7,4),(8,0),(8,1),(8,2). If d=3g-3+n, Poincare duality realizes this as W_{2d-16}H^{2d-16}(M_{g,n})(d); the untwisted ordinary group has Tate type Q(-(d-8)) and Chow codimension d-8.
